en.tagline: The notes of the I. M. Gelfand seminar at Moscow State University, 1964–1989, with a critical companion: every talk summarised, every mathematical item stated precisely with its fate and present status, a problem index across the years, and the bibliography.
en.status_companion: Critical companion: AI-written commentary by {model}, {written}. Mathematical statuses are dated; results marked “proved here” or “computed here” were proved or computed for this companion. Not yet reviewed: every statement, attribution and status in it is the model's own and unchecked.
en.status_companion_many: Critical companion: AI-written commentary by {model}, written {written}, one chapter per academic year. Not yet reviewed: every statement, attribution and status in it is the model's own and unchecked. Notes: {notebook}
en.status_notebook: AI-translated from the Russian diplomatic transcription (itself AI-transcribed and checked against the scans); state of {date} (release {release}). Scans: MCCME.
en.status_notebook_both: Notebook text: Russian diplomatic transcription (AI-transcribed, checked against the scans) and its English translation (AI-translated); state of {date} (release {release}). Scans: MCCME.
en.stale: The transcription of {pages} has been revised since this commentary was written ({written}): {what}. The current text is release {release} of {date}. Readings quoted here may differ from the current text.
en.stale_year: {n} of the {m} notebook pages of this chapter have been revised since the commentary was written ({written}); the talks and items concerned carry a notice.
en.stale_none_year: None of the {m} notebook pages of this chapter has been revised since the commentary was written ({written}).
en.stub_year: Stub. The companion for {year} has not been written yet. The notes of this year are linked below.
en.stub_talk: Stub. The companion for {year} has not been written yet. The notes of this talk are linked below.
en.no_entry: The companion for this year has no entry for this record ({label}).
en.chapter_covers: This chapter of the companion covers {years}.
en.chapter_written: Chapter of the companion for {years}; written {written}.
en.speaker: Speaker
en.title: Title
en.notebook_col_note: The notebook pages of this record, with the scans at MCCME and the pages of the two reader PDFs. The catalogue associates each record with a window of pages that it shares with its neighbours; the companion gives the pages of the talk itself.
en.date_fix: The catalogue prints the date as “{catalogued}”; it is {date}: {reason}
en.date_differs: The catalogue dates this record {catalogued}; the companion dates the talk {date}.
en.empty_record: The archive has no pages for this record (a talk without notes).
en.beyond_window: The companion places this talk on {pages}, beyond the catalogue's window for the record.
en.class_legend: Classes: A published soon after by the speaker or by Gelfand; B developed by others; C partly developed; D not developed; E known before the talk (expository); F not identifiable from the notes. The class is shown with the independent assessments; it never stands alone.
en.class_A: published soon after by the speaker or by Gelfand
en.pending: in a year without a companion chapter
en.readers_text: The Russian diplomatic transcription and the English translation of all 1,527 notebook pages, as two PDF readers (release {release}).
en.data_text: Everything on this site as machine-readable files (CSV and JSON):
en.about_text: The notes are the notebooks of the seminar kept at the MCCME archive (catalogue: {mccme}); the note taker named by the archive is M. A. Shubin. The transcription, the translation and the companion are published in the repository {repo}.
en.corrections_page: Emendations proposed by the companion (mathematical errors faithfully copied from the notebook)
en.speaker_index_text: Every talk by speaker, as named in the companion (or, for years without a companion, in the MCCME catalogue).
en.problems_index_text: Precise questions and conjectures that recur across the years or that later literature took up. A problem met in several chapters is shown once, with the status of its latest entry; every chapter's entry stays visible on its page.
en.references_text: Every work cited by the companion ({n} entries), with the items that cite it. “verified” means the companion's author opened the work.
en.not_found_text: This address is not a page of the site.
en.rights: The rights in the original work belong to its author or the author's representatives or heirs. Where we hold rights, in the AI-produced transcription, translation, corrections and typesetting, they are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. This edition is published for educational, non-profit purposes, and we claim no rights we do not hold. If you hold rights in this work and object to its publication here, please open a GitHub issue and we will take it down.
